title: Carciofi alla Giudia (Roman Twice-Fried Whole Artichokes)
summary: Whole trimmed artichokes are fried gently at 150-160 °C until tender, opened and de-choked, then fried again at 180 °C until bronzed and crisp. Served hot with salt and lemon.
equipment: deep heavy pot or Dutch oven

ingredients.note: about 1200 g whole; about 480 g once trimmed

ingredients.item: neutral frying oil (sunflower, rapeseed or vegetable)
fine sea salt or table salt
lemon, cut into wedges, to serve

steps.title: Trim the artichokes
steps.text: Squeeze the lemon halves into the cold water and drop them in. Snap off the tough outer leaves of one artichoke until only pale ones remain. Peel the stem, leaving 5 cm, pare the base into a smooth round and cut off the top 2-3 cm. Keep it in the lemon water while you trim the rest.

steps.title: First fry
steps.text: Heat oil 7-8 cm deep to 150-160 °C. Drain the artichokes, pat them completely dry, tap them upside down to loosen the leaves and rub with half the salt and the pepper. Fry for 12-15 min, turning, until a knife slides easily into the thickest part of the stem. Drain stem up on the tray.

steps.title: Open them out
steps.text: When cool enough to handle, spread the leaves gently outwards like a flower and scoop out any hairy choke from the centre.

steps.title: Second fry
steps.text: Heat the oil to 180 °C and fry the artichokes for 1-2 min, head down first, until bronzed and crackling. Drain, sprinkle with the remaining salt and serve at once with lemon wedges.

tips: Test the first fry with a knife in the thickest part of the stem: once it slides in easily the artichoke is cooked, and the hotter second fry is only for colour and crunch.
Wear gloves while trimming, or rub your hands with lemon, to stop staining.
Keep the trimmed artichokes in the lemon water until the oil is hot, so they don't turn brown.
safety: Frying safety: use a heavy, deep pot no more than half full of oil, with a clip-on thermometer, and dry the food before it goes in. Never leave hot oil unattended. If the oil catches fire, turn off the heat and cover the pot with a metal lid or use a fire extinguisher; never use water.
Dry the artichokes thoroughly before frying; water makes the hot oil spit.
storage: Best eaten straight away. After the first fry they can wait at room temperature for up to 2 hours before the second fry. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
